arguments.name: associatePublicIpAddress
arguments.description: (Optional) Associate a public ip address with an instance in a VPC.

arguments.name: ebsOptimized
arguments.description: (Optional) If true, the launched EC2 instance will be EBS-optimized.

arguments.name: enableMonitoring
arguments.description: (Optional) Enables/disables detailed monitoring. This is enabled by default.

arguments.name: iamInstanceProfile
arguments.description: (Optional) The name attribute of the IAM instance profile to associate with launched instances.

arguments.name: imageId
arguments.description: (Required) The EC2 image ID to launch.

arguments.name: instanceType
arguments.description: (Required) The size of instance to launch.

arguments.name: keyName
arguments.description: (Optional) The key name that should be used for the instance.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Optional) The name of the launch configuration. If you leave this blank, Terraform will auto-generate a unique name. Conflicts with `namePrefix`.

arguments.name: namePrefix
arguments.description: (Optional) Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with `name`.

arguments.name: placementTenancy
arguments.description: (Optional) The tenancy of the instance. Valid values are `default` or `dedicated`, see [AWS's Create Launch Configuration](http://docs.aws.amazon.com/AutoScaling/latest/APIReference/API_CreateLaunchConfiguration.html) for more details.

arguments.name: securityGroups
arguments.description: (Optional) A list of associated security group IDS.

arguments.name: spotPrice
arguments.description: (Optional; Default: On-demand price) The maximum price to use for reserving spot instances.

arguments.name: userData
arguments.description: (Optional) The user data to provide when launching the instance. Do not pass gzip-compressed data via this argument; see `userDataBase64` instead.

arguments.name: userDataBase64
arguments.description: (Optional) Can be used instead of `userData` to pass base64-encoded binary data directly. Use this instead of `userData` whenever the value is not a valid UTF-8 string. For example, gzip-encoded user data must be base64-encoded and passed via this argument to avoid corruption.

arguments.name: deleteOnTermination
arguments.description: (Optional) Whether the volume should be destroyed on instance termination (Default: `true`).

arguments.name: deviceName
arguments.description: (Required) The name of the device to mount.

arguments.name: encrypted
arguments.description: (Optional) Whether the volume should be encrypted or not. Defaults to `false`.

arguments.name: iops
arguments.description: (Optional) The amount of provisioned [IOPS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-io-characteristics.html).

arguments.name: noDevice
arguments.description: (Optional) Whether the device in the block device mapping of the AMI is suppressed.

arguments.name: snapshotId
arguments.description: (Optional) The Snapshot ID to mount.

arguments.name: throughput
arguments.description: (Optional) The throughput (MiBps) to provision for a `gp3` volume.

arguments.name: volumeSize
arguments.description: (Optional) The size of the volume in gigabytes.

arguments.name: volumeType
arguments.description: (Optional) The type of volume. Can be `standard`, `gp2`, `gp3`, `st1`, `sc1` or `io1`.

arguments.name: deviceName
arguments.description: (Required) The name of the block device to mount on the instance.

arguments.name: noDevice
arguments.description: (Optional) Whether the device in the block device mapping of the AMI is suppressed.

arguments.name: virtualName
arguments.description: (Optional) The [Instance Store Device Name](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html#InstanceStoreDeviceNames).
